rationale.hitl-workflow: Proposes Human-in-Command, shifting human control to envelope definition and exception gating.
rationale.oversight-theater: Critiques HITL as Scapegoat-as-a-Service where reviewers rubber-stamp due to throughput pressure.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Requires verifiable provenance inputs and deterministic payloads for immutable audit logs.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Requires deterministic engines to evaluate policy constraints before action execution.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Pre-execution receipt provides intent and action preview to support human judgment.
rationale.counterpoint: Argues against HITL as a safety control, calling it liability transfer.
